**Daily Devotional**

**June 2**

*7 And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated. (Deuteronomy 34:7 KJV)*

Notice how good God was to Moses, that he lived to be 120 years old, and was in perfect health. When you serve our Lord, He will look after you, and the closer you walk with Him the more He will bless you. Our God is such a good God, and yet religion has led people to believe that God is full of anger and wrath against us, and have used fear to try to bring people to be saved. The bible tells us that fear has torment (1 John 4:18), and that condemnation will cause people to fall away from God, and yet religion uses those things to try and make us serve God. If you serve God because of the fear of the wrath of God, then you will not want to do much for Him. There is no condemnation to those that are born again and serving the Lord (Romans 8:1), and condemnation is a tool of the devil.

The true nature of God is love, for God is love (1 John 4:8). If religion would just teach the love of God, they would find out that people would serve Him better out of love than out of fear, as the grace of God teaches us to live for Him (Titus 2:11-12). Satan has sure been good at deceiving the church. Put your faith in a good God, and rejoice.
